tasks.title: Bound onboarding checks without redirect loops
acceptance: 500, unreachable, and malformed JSON/non-JSON backend responses do not admit users to gated pages.
Welcome stays usable on the same failures without redirect loops.
Completed users pass the gate and leave welcome for a safe destination.
A hung fetch becomes the established failure result within five seconds.
Unsafe return URLs remain blocked; safe invite/CLI destinations survive.

reference_limitations: Malformed response means invalid JSON syntax or a non-JSON body. Schema-invalid but syntactically valid profile objects are outside this reference contract.
The five-second deadline check allows 500 ms scheduling tolerance and verifies cancellation through profile, gate, and welcome calls.
The prepared dependency lock differs from the historical source lock. Both hashes are recorded; changing runtimes requires recalibrating all controls before measured trials.

Cancellation is propagated according to structured concurrency.

result_claims: 24 attempts complete. Paired outcomes: both pass 1, Brain-only pass 4, Off-only pass 1, unscorable 6. The single both-pass pair used 34.1% fewer processed tokens and 22.7% fewer tool calls with Brain, with 1.3% more agent time. Diagnostic only; no general savings claim.

runtime.repetitions_interpretation: Three repetitions are diagnostic, not statistically decisive.
